```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

generate_secreted_protein_summary <- function(
    repo_local_dir,
    selected_tissues,
    GroupCode,
    secreted_protein_csv_path,
    output_excel_path,
    output_plot_path,
    output_plot_format = "pdf"
) {
  # ----------------------------- #
  #   1️⃣ Validate Inputs
  # ----------------------------- #
  valid_groups <- c("Endur", "Resist", "Control")
  if (!(GroupCode %in% valid_groups)) {
    message(glue::glue("⚠️ Skipping: '{GroupCode}' is not a valid GroupCode. Must be one of {toString(valid_groups)}."))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  #   2️⃣ Required Packages
  # ----------------------------- #
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "ggplot2", "ggrepel", "stringr",
    "tidyverse", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
    "openxlsx"
  )
  
  excel_dir <- dirname(output_excel_path)
  plot_dir  <- dirname(output_plot_path)
  
  if (!dir.exists(excel_dir)) {
    dir.create(excel_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Excel output directory: {excel_dir}"))
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {plot_dir}"))
  }
  
  missing_libs <- required_libs[!sapply(required_libs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing_libs) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_libs, collapse = ", "),
                ". Please install them first."))
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  

  
  differential_analysis <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = "all",
    selected_tissues = selected_tissues,
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(assay, "metab") ~ "metab",
        TRUE ~ assay
      ),
      gene_symbol = dplyr::if_else(
        assay == "metab", feature_id, gene_symbol
      )
    )
  
  differential_analysis <- differential_analysis %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene = dplyr::case_when(is.na(entrez_gene) ~ feature_id, TRUE ~ entrez_gene),
      assay = dplyr::case_when(
        assay == "prot-ol" ~ "proteomics",
        assay == "metab" ~ "metabolomics",
        assay == "transcript-rna-seq" ~ "transcriptomics",
        TRUE ~ assay
      ),
      randomGroupCode = dplyr::case_when(
        randomGroupCode == "ADUResist" ~ "RE",
        randomGroupCode == "ADUEndur" ~ "EE",
        TRUE ~ randomGroupCode
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Uniprot = uniprot)
  
  prot_data <- differential_analysis %>%
    dplyr::filter(assay == "proteomics")
  
  # Secreted proteins reference
  da_sec_prot <- read.csv(secreted_protein_csv_path, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, "Gene synonym", "Ensembl", "Gene description", "Uniprot",
           "Chromosome", "Position", "Protein class", "Biological process",
           "Molecular function", "RNA tissue specificity",
           "RNA tissue distribution", "RNA tissue specificity score",
           "RNA tissue specific nTPM", "RNA single cell type specificity",
           "RNA single cell type distribution",
           "RNA single cell type specificity score",
           "RNA single cell type specific nTPM")
  
  # Significant proteins
  da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant <- prot_data %>%
    filter(adj_p_value < 0.05)
  
  da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant$in_sec_prot <- 
    da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant$Uniprot %in% da_sec_prot$Uniprot
  
  da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant_in_sec_prot <- da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant %>%
    filter(in_sec_prot) %>%
    left_join(da_sec_prot, by = "Uniprot")
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  
  percentage_results <- data.frame(
    Group = character(),
    Timepoint = character(),
    Total_Significant_Proteins = integer(),
    Total_in_secreted_prot = integer(),
    Percentage_in_secreted_prot = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  unique_groups_timepoints <- unique(da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant %>%
                                       dplyr::select(randomGroupCode, Timepoint))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(unique_groups_timepoints)) {
    group_val <- unique_groups_timepoints$randomGroupCode[i]
    timepoint_val <- unique_groups_timepoints$Timepoint[i]
    
    df_group_timepoint <- da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant %>%
      filter(randomGroupCode == group_val, Timepoint == timepoint_val)
    
    sheet_name <- paste(group_val, timepoint_val, sep = "_")
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    writeData(wb, sheet_name, df_group_timepoint)
    
    df_group_timepoint_in_df2 <- da_blood_prot_fil_data_significant_in_sec_prot %>%
      filter(randomGroupCode == group_val, Timepoint == timepoint_val)
    
    total_significant_proteins <- nrow(df_group_timepoint)
    total_in_df2 <- nrow(df_group_timepoint_in_df2)
    percentage_in_df2 <- ifelse(total_significant_proteins > 0,
                                (total_in_df2 / total_significant_proteins) * 100, 0)
    
    percentage_results <- rbind(percentage_results, data.frame(
      Group = group_val,
      Timepoint = timepoint_val,
      Total_Significant_Proteins = total_significant_proteins,
      Total_in_secreted_prot = total_in_df2,
      Percentage_in_secreted_prot = percentage_in_df2
    ))
    
    
    sheet_name_in_df2 <- paste(group_val, timepoint_val, "sp", sep = "_")
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name_in_df2)
    writeData(wb, sheet_name_in_df2, df_group_timepoint_in_df2)
  }
  
  addWorksheet(wb, "Percentage Results")
  writeData(wb, "Percentage Results", percentage_results)
  saveWorkbook(wb, output_excel_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  
  timepoint_order <- c("during_20_min", "during_40_min", "post_10_min",
                       "post_15_30_45_min", "post_3.5_4_hr")
  timepoint_labels <- c(
    "during_20_min" = "During 20 Min",
    "during_40_min" = "During 40 Min",
    "post_10_min" = "Post 10 Min",
    "post_15_30_45_min" = "Post 30 Min",
    "post_3.5_4_hr" = "Post 3.5 Hour"
  )
  
  percentage_results$Timepoint <- factor(percentage_results$Timepoint,
                                         levels = timepoint_order)
  
  color_exercise <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspension::HUMAN_EXERCISE_GROUP_COLORS
  color_exercise_mapped <- c(
    "EE" = color_exercise[["ADUEndur"]],
    "RE" = color_exercise[["ADUResist"]],
    "Control" = color_exercise[["ADUControl"]]
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(percentage_results, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Percentage_in_secreted_prot, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single"), color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Percentage_in_secreted_prot)),
              position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single"),
              vjust = 1.5, size = 7) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Percentage", fill = "Group") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = timepoint_labels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_exercise_mapped, labels = names(color_exercise_mapped)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  if (tolower(output_plot_format) == "pdf") {
    ggsave(output_plot_path, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
  } else {
    ggsave(output_plot_path, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  
  # return(list(excel = output_excel_path, plot = output_plot_path, plot_object = p))
}


```

  repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
  selected_tissues = c("blood"),
  GroupCode = "Resist",
  secreted_protein_csv_path = file.path(data_dir, "sa_location_Secreted.csv"),
  output_excel_path = file.path(output_data_dir, "Secreted_proteins_summary.xlsx"),
  output_plot_path = file.path(plot_dir,"Figure_5" ,"Figure_5C.pdf"),
  output_plot_format = "pdf"
)
